papers.title: Numerical Analysis of 2D Stochastic Navier--Stokes Equations with Transport Noise: Regularity and Spatial Semidiscretization
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2512.03483v4 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: This paper establishes a strong convergence rate for the spatial finite element discretization of a two-dimensional stochastic Navier--Stokes system with transport noise and no-slip boundary conditions on a convex polygonal domain. The main challenge arises from the lack of spatial $D(A)$-regularity of the solutio (where $A$ is the Stokes operator), which prevents the direct applicability of standard error analysis techniques. Under a smallness assumption on the transport noise, for a MINI-element spatial semidiscretization, we establish a strong convergence rate of order $h^{\varrho} \log\big(1 + \frac{1}{h}\big)$, where $\varrho \in (0,1/2)$.
